'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Brandon Schele LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title The Fake Revolution. Sheet Sal'torr → [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)]]. Starts [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]] with [[It Is The Future You See / Free Ride]]. Sheet Objective line marked (V); published non-(V) objective title. Goo Nee Tay as Interrupt.

* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
